messages:
morgan: FYI incoming pen test Wk of Aug 2. Need scope, RBAC changes, KMS plan, and evidence handoff owners. Who picks up the impact matrix and KMS lifecycle?

rachel: I can own the impact matrix. Quick Q: readonly log export for assessors or full readroom access?

kevin: Prefer readonly S3 export + presigned URLs for artifacts. Live readroom only if they request interactive access; otherwise ephemeral sessions.

aj: For KMS, we must avoid giving assessors decrypt on prod keys. Proposal: create a pt-evidence CMK with limited GenerateDataKey for our packager and issue short-lived grants for Decrypt. Revoke/rotate after engagement.

sam: +1. Also ensure CloudTrail records kms:Decrypt and kms:GenerateDataKey. Export KMS logs to SIEM and enable S3 access logs for the evidence bucket.

morgan: Plan: Rachel -> impact matrix. Kevin -> packaging & presigned automation. AJ -> KMS runbook + revoke steps. Sam -> telemetry checklist. I'll draft one-pager for assessors.

rachel: Impact matrix cols: service, sensitivity, roles, temp-roles, evidence-location, owner. Sheet: https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1PT-INTAKE-EXAMPLE (comment pls)

kevin: Packaging example snippet:
```bash
# bundle and upload
bundle_name=bundle-pt123.tar.gz
tar -czf /tmp/$bundle_name /opt/artifacts && aws s3 cp /tmp/$bundle_name s3://pt-evidence-bucket/pt-123/
# encrypt locally with CMK via GenerateDataKey
```

kevin: Presigned URLs: 24h expiry, enable object-lock retention 30d.

aj: CMK policy sketch: allow GenerateDataKey only to packager principal; Decrypt via grants issued to assessor role. Post-engagement revoke grants and rotate key.

kevin: Draft role policy idea (we'll fill grant id at issuance):
```json
{"Version":"2012-10-17","Statement":[{"Effect":"Allow","Action":["s3:GetObject","s3:ListBucket"],"Resource":"arn:aws:s3:::pt-evidence-bucket/*"},{"Effect":"Allow","Action":["kms:Decrypt"],"Resource":"arn:aws:kms:...:alias/pt-evidence","Condition":{"StringEquals":{"kms:GrantId":"PLACEHOLDER"}}}]}
```

morgan: DevOps infra ticket? @devops-bot can you open one for alias and param entries?

devops-bot: Drafted INFRA-PT-7190. Tuesdays available to pair on deploy.

sam: Telemetry checklist: CloudTrail retention for engagement+90d, S3 access logs to secure bucket, KMS API logged to SIEM, VPC flow logs for any readroom bastions.

rachel: For remediation tracking, use vuln tracker board and tag with pt-7190. Add 'verified-by-assessor' checkbox. Who triages findings during engagement?

morgan: Security triage lead: aj. Ops fixes: kevin. Evidence & validation: rachel.

aj: Triage playbook: immediate mitigation steps, upload proof artifacts to presigned URL, remediation PR template must include evidence link and test steps for assessor. Retest protocol: request via assessor form.

kevin: Retest cadence suggestion: 72h for initial triage, 7d remediation for non-P0, retest slots Tue/Thu. Assessor availability TBD.

morgan: @security-bot any assessor windows?

security-bot: Assessor tentative slots Aug 3-5 and Aug 10-12. Confirm by Jul 25.

rachel: Locking impact matrix now and will ping assessors. AJ will you add KMS revoke runbook to the sheet?

aj: Yes, adding runbook steps and rollback playbook.

morgan: Contingency: if active exploit simulation occurs, trigger incident runbook and escalate to oncall. I've linked the runbook in the sheet. Reconvene Mon EOD to finalize. :thumbsup:

devops-bot: Reminder set for Mon 16:00 PTO.
